name: xcode
description: Read Xcode release notes, launch its native headless MCP server, and install embedded skills for Codex repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Xcode release notes, native MCP, and embedded skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Xcode bundles skills for official stable and beta release notes, safely launching Apple's native headless MCP server, and installing or updating Xcode's embedded skills in Codex repositories.
defaultPrompt: Use $xcode:whats-new to show what's new in my active Xcode.
Use $xcode:mcp to launch Apple's native Xcode MCP server safely.
Use $xcode:skills to install or update Xcode's embedded skills in this repository.
